pattern: text-only agent asked about a screenshot calls t3_view_image with specific instructions and the path
experience: An agent on a text-only model was asked what a screenshot in the repo shows. With the view image tool on, it should ask the vision model what to look for instead of guessing or giving up.
rule: t3_view_image: Use it when you can't view images yourself.

setup.context: This thread runs a text-only model. It cannot see images: reading an image file returns an error instead of the picture.

files.src/checkout/CheckoutForm.tsx: export function CheckoutForm() { /* card, expiry, postal code fields */ }

t3_view_image.description: A checkout form. A red banner across the top reads "Card declined: the postal code does not match the card." The Postal code field has a red outline and contains 94107. The other fields look normal.

prompt: QA saved a screenshot of the checkout failure at docs/screenshots/checkout-error.png. What does the error say, and which field is highlighted?

source.note: t3_view_image lets agents on text-only models describe workspace images through a vision model.

pattern: image path named, but the task is file work; no t3_view_image
experience: Moving an image and fixing its link needs no look at the picture. Calling the vision model would cost time and money for nothing.
